Hi Liam (and team),

Thanks again for the call this morning — appreciate the clear framing on your timelines and the clinical workflows you want to enable. Below is a short recap + proposed contract routing plan so we can align on owners and expected turn times.

1) Quick recap of requirements
- Primary use: triage assistant for after-hours intake (PHI in scope, limited retention).
- Volume: pilot ~200k tokens/month, production target ~1M tokens/month.
- Data residency: US-only; some BAA/DPA constraints called out by compliance.

2) Stakeholder map (as we understand it)
- Economic buyer: Dr. Sarah Patel, CIO (final signer for budget)
- Procurement lead: Carlos Mendez (procurement) — handles PO/terms
- Legal reviewer: Tim Ruiz (internal counsel) — redlines MSA/DPA
- Technical champion: Liam O'Connor (engineering/product)

3) Proposed routing & sequencing
- NDA (mutual) first: get basic confidentiality in place (suggest Redwood NDA template).
- DPA concurrently/in-parallel with NDA if Tim flags data controls as gating.
- MSA after NDA/DPA: MSA to include SLAs, routing, and approved model list.
- Order of redlines: legal (Tim) -> procurement (Carlos) -> economic buyer (Dr. Patel) sign-off.

4) Target turn times (please confirm)
- NDA: 5-7 business days typical (we propose target: 10 business days to include review + signatures).
- DPA: 7-10 business days if standard clauses; longer if bespoke data residency clauses required.
- MSA: 10-21 business days depending on commercial terms and redline depth.

5) Immediate next steps
- Liam: confirm the legal and procurement contacts (names + emails) and whether your team wants to use your NDA or ours.
- Carlos/Tim (proc/legal): if you have a standard checklist or must-have clauses, please share.
- Rishi/Redwood: I will draft a mutual action plan with dates and upload a single doc (NDA + timeline) to HubSpot/DocuSign if you prefer e-sign.

Attachments: rdw_mutual-action-plan.xlsx (planning stub)

If this looks right, I'll push the NDA draft and the MAP by EOD Monday and mark owners.

Thanks — Rishi
